|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export TMP_UNSET_VAR=present
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ env | grep TMP_UNSET_VAR
|TMP_UNSET_VAR=present
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

== frame after_unset cursor=9,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export TMP_UNSET_VAR=present
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ env | grep TMP_UNSET_VAR
|TMP_UNSET_VAR=present
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ unset TMP_UNSET_VAR
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ env | grep TMP_UNSET_VAR
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 export
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 env
@5 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@5 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 unset
@7 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~

@9 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
